trainers.instruction: Steve finally reaches the check-in counter. Read his conversation with the staff.

atoms.text: Hi, I noticed the check-in for the flight to New York has just closed a few minutes ago, but I was waiting in the queue when that happened. Is there any way you can help me?
Unfortunately, we are unable to add any more passengers once check-in closes, even if they were waiting in the queue.
That’s so frustrating. I’ve been here the whole time! What are my options now?
I completely understand, and I’m sorry for the inconvenience. I recommend heading to the service desk. They can check for alternative flights later today.

trainers.instruction: Read Steve’s conversation with the airline agent.

atoms.text: Hi, I missed check-in for my flight and the desk staff sent me here. I need to find another flight to New York today or tomorrow at the latest.
Of course, let me check what we have available.
Alright, there are a few alternative flights later today, but you will need to purchase a new ticket for whichever one you choose.
